# page-pane

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Web pages in a side pane, in the Browser's own rendering: the web-page pane (web/:url;page) shows one page of the engine's Chromium beside the pane that linked to it, under the browser's toolbar (nav controls, omnibox, actions; the tab strip only once the page opened a popup), its remote page keyed in the URL so a reload re-attaches it, and Expand hands that very page to the Browser app's tabs. useWebPageLink(url) is the link that opens it — plain click opens the pane, ⌘/middle-click leaves the site to a new browser tab.
- Web:
  - Slots: `webPagePane.Actions`
  - Slot contributors: `webPagePane.Actions` ← `primitives.pane`
  - Contributes: `Pane.Register` "web-page"
  - Uses:
    - `apps-core/tabs.useAppLink`
    - `apps/browser/shell.Browser`
    - `apps/browser/shell.BrowserTabsStore`
    - `apps/browser/shell.BrowserToolbar`
    - `apps/browser/shell.singlePageTabs`
    - `apps/browser/shell.useAddBrowserTab`
    - `apps/browser/shell.useBrowserTabs`
    - `primitives/css/clip.Clip`
    - `primitives/css/rigid.rigidClass`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.cn`
    - `primitives/pane.defineRoute`
    - `primitives/pane.Pane`
    - `primitives/pane.PaneChrome`
    - `primitives/pane.PaneExpandTarget`
    - `primitives/pane.useOpenPane`
  - Exports (values):
    - `useWebPageLink`
    - `webPagePane`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `conversations/conversation-view/markdown-extensions`
